lockFileMaintenance.description: Moves what uv.lock pins beyond the groups' own pins, those they pull in, to their newest releases

poetry.description: Not a poetry project, but supersedes default pep manager if left enabled.

git-submodules.description: Off while rexlib has no releases: main moves several times a day, and every push opened a pull request. CI moves the submodule itself instead; turn this back on and drop that step once rexlib tags versions worth pinning to.

customManagers.description: The version of uv that writes uv.lock, which CI installs too

packageRules.description: Cap the numpy 3.10 pin to releases that still support 3.10; 2.3.0 raised requires-python to >=3.11.
Cap the numpy 3.11 pin to releases that still support 3.11; 2.5.0 raised requires-python to >=3.12.
rexlib is first-party and every job here builds it from source, so a commit need not settle before being bumped.
